## Problem

Describe the user or developer need. Explain why it belongs in the shared
library instead of a consuming application.

## Solution

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it belongs in the shared library.

## Compatibility

State whether this changes public props, exports, tokens, the Tailwind preset,

path for breaking changes.

## Validation

- [ ] TypeScript, lint, tests, and package verification pass
- [ ] Storybook story added or updated
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, screen-reader, and reduced-motion behavior checked

- [ ] Breaking API, token, preset, or dependency changes identified
